project_title: Mapping Chemical Stability and Environmental Persistence through UBP Framework

hypothesis.primary: Environmentally persistent plastics exhibit distinct UBP signatures (higher Symmetry Tax, lower Stability Score) compared to biodegradable materials
hypothesis.secondary: Toxic chemical additives show distinct Coherence Regimes compared to inert base polymers

steps.name: Environment Setup and Validation
tasks: Install required packages: pandas, numpy, matplotlib, scipy
Test UBP system imports and basic functionality
steps.success_criteria: All UBP modules import successfully, test case runs without errors

steps.name: Chemical Data Collection
tasks: Collect chemical formulas, SMILES, molecular weights
Collect atomic composition (C, H, O, N, Cl counts)
Collect real-world properties: biodegradability, persistence, toxicity
steps.success_criteria: CSV file with ≥10 materials, complete property data

steps.name: Design Molecular Resonance Mapping
steps.success_criteria: Bit generator produces valid 24-bit vectors for all test chemicals

steps.name: UBP Analysis Pipeline
tasks: Process each chemical through UBP Core v4.2.6
Extract NRCI, Coherence Regime, Symmetry Tax, Stability Score
Save full results to JSON and CSV
steps.success_criteria: Complete metrics for all materials, no processing errors

steps.name: Statistical Analysis
tasks: Correlation: Symmetry Tax vs. Environmental Persistence
Statistical tests: Mann-Whitney U, Spearman correlation
steps.success_criteria: p-values, effect sizes, and confidence intervals computed

steps.name: Visualization and Interpretation
tasks: Scatter plot: Stability Score vs. Persistence
Box plots: UBP metrics by material category
Heatmap: All UBP metrics across materials
3D projection: Leech Lattice dimensions colored by biodegradability
steps.success_criteria: 4-5 clear, labeled figures saved as PNG + PDF

steps.name: Documentation and Reproducibility
steps.success_criteria: External researcher can reproduce results from documentation

steps.name: Results Synthesis
tasks: Write scientific summary (Abstract, Methods, Results, Discussion)

success_criteria_overall: Complete dataset of ≥10 chemicals with UBP metrics
Statistical analysis showing whether hypothesis is supported
Clear interpretation of UBP signatures in chemical context
Code runs end-to-end without manual intervention
